references.text: Joshua commands the people to prepare to cross the Jordan to take possession of the land that the Lord gives them.
Describes the actual crossing of the Jordan, where the priests stood on dry ground while the people crossed over.
Moses reminds the people that they must cross the Jordan to drive out the nations and take possession of the land.
Introduction to the laws Israel is to keep when they enter the land the Lord gives them.
Continuation of the regulations concerning the land they are to take possession of.
The Lord commands Israel to take possession of the land and settle there, for he has given them the land.
Instructions that apply when the people cross the Jordan into the land of Canaan.
Moses presents commandments and regulations that are to be kept in the land they are to take possession of.
